question: Joining Time is treated as duty and Joining Time pay is equal to pay drawn before relinquishment of charge of the old post/after assuming charge of the new post.
Holidays cannot be prefixed / suffixed with Joining Time.
Joining time cannot be combined with Casual Leave / EOL.
Heads of Department may extend Joining Time by up to 15 days/30 days.
If increment falls during the period of Joining Time, the enhanced pay on account of increment will be drawn on date of joining duty/commencement of Joining Time.
